9f51518654363fad40fcda99a1eb2a8d.overview: In 1910s Paris, a sewer worker disillusioned with Christianity feels his prayers have been answered when he chances upon a street waif and they fall in love.

9f9360bb470039bcacfe79c4e429d787.tagline: The story of a love that became the most fearful thing that ever happened to a woman!

9f97a5ce5dafeadd2f4d3d0d06065162.overview: Swope—the only black man on the executive board of an advertising firm—is accidentally put in charge after the death of the chairman.

9fb25d8596bb969ac421ce3187383797.tagline: Five good reasons to stay single.

9fc501e78917076787c275a7f914249d.overview: When elderly pensioner Umberto Domenico Ferrari returns to his boarding house from a protest calling for a hike in old-age pensions, his landlady demands her 15,000-lire rent by the end of the month or he and his small dog will be turned out onto the street. Unable to get the money in time, Umberto fakes illness to get sent to a hospital, giving his beloved dog to the landlady's pregnant and abandoned maid for temporary safekeeping.

9fe6c596f09c82464c2eadc94d2024eb.overview: A nineteenth-century New Hampshire farmer makes a pact with Satan for economic success, then enlists famed orator Daniel Webster to extract him from his contract.
